Market today: The market is grappling with volatile Treasury yields, which hit new multi-year highs before pulling back slightly. Inflation and spending concerns are the real drivers, directly impacting your tech/chip heavy portfolio by increasing borrowing costs and discounting future earnings.

Your holdings: SOXL is down nearly 50% and SPAL is down over 36%, both leveraged ETFs with stops already blown. SMH is also down over 10% and flagged for trimming. Remember, margin amplifies these drops significantly.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yield movements; they are the primary external factor for your portfolio. Also, monitor SOXL and SPAL for any further downside given their leveraged nature and current losses.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage risk on your leveraged, underperforming positions, especially with ongoing rate volatility.
plays: SOXL: Your stop at 200 is far above the current price of 129.1, indicating a significant breach. Re-evaluate this leveraged position immediately to manage the nearly 50% loss.
SPAL: This new leveraged ETF is down over 36% and below its stop of 21.38. Address this position promptly to contain further losses.
SMH: Consider trimming this chip ETF as flagged, especially with ongoing rate concerns. Its stop is 540, current price 569.77.
